LINK-HEALTH AUDIT OF THE SOURCE INDEX
Run 2026-09-07. 441 distinct URLs tested, one request each, following
redirects, with a browser user-agent.

WHAT WAS TESTED AND WHAT WAS NOT. sources.json holds 1,717 records, 1,407 of
them with a URL. Excluded from this pass: archive.org (778, item pages that do
not rot the way ordinary web pages do), en.wikipedia.org (50), newspapers.com
and facebook.com (paywalled and login-walled, so a code says nothing), and
web.archive.org (21, which THIS ENVIRONMENT CANNOT REACH FOR ITS OWN REASONS --
see f_5361 -- so any result would have been a fact about the proxy). That
leaves 441.

=====================================================================
THE HEADLINE: 347 OF 441 ARE FINE
=====================================================================

  200  347      403   50      404   10      000    9      202    7
  999    5      429    5      502    2      503    1      500    1
  422    1      410    1      401    1      400    1

=====================================================================
THE 403/429/999 CLASS IS NOT LINK ROT -- DO NOT "FIX" IT
=====================================================================

Fifty 403s, five 429s and five 999s, and they cluster exactly where a site
blocks automated requests: legacy.com (6), acacamps.org (6), ebay.com (3),
tandfonline.com (2), ourkids.net (2), bac-lac.gc.ca (2), youtube.com (4 x 429),
linkedin.com and ca.linkedin.com (5 x 999 -- LinkedIn's own bot-refusal code),
instagram.com. THESE PAGES ARE ALMOST CERTAINLY LIVE IN A BROWSER. A 403 here
is a fact about our request, not about the page, and anyone tidying the index
should leave them alone.

Same for the 202s (ydesfemmesmtl.org, imdb.com) and the 000s, which are the
proxy's tunnel drops rather than anything about the target.

=====================================================================
GENUINE ROT: ELEVEN URLS, AND WHERE EACH ONE WENT
=====================================================================

RECOVERABLE FROM THE INTERNET ARCHIVE (six). Capture dates from
archive.org's availability API, which works here while web.archive.org does
not; all HTTP 200:

  src_cmat_caddell_obituary        2021-12-02   James Caddell's obituary
  src_devp_leduc_2015              2016-06-26   Development & Peace on Leduc
  src_viu_news_twynam_award        2022-10-02   VIU on Dean Twynam's award
  src_westislandblog_oolahwan      2020-10-27   Camp Oolahwan centennial
  src_dawson_chris_adam            2019-07-20   Dawson on Chris Adam
  src_campcode_95                  2021-11-23   Camp Code podcast episode 95

FIXED LIVE, IN PLACE (one). src_canadian_encyclopedia_ymca pointed at
/en/article/ymca, which 404s. The article is at
/en/article/young-mens-christian-association and returns 200 with 203 KB.
ANOTHER URL WRONG IN OUR OWN RECORD, the second found today after the McGill
News article (f_5364).

NO CAPTURE AND NO LIVE REPLACEMENT FOUND (four):
  src_nfb_nothing_sacred           HTTP 410 -- the NFB has deliberately
                                   withdrawn the page, not lost it
  src_schleisscarter_team          the recorded path is "/iteami", which is
                                   not a word; /team also 404s
  src_lcc_lion_2024                issuu.com/lowercanadaschool 404s and
                                   issuu.com/lowercanadacollege 404s too
  src_vss_reglement_zonage_222_2008  a Saint-Sauveur zoning by-law PDF

AND ONE THAT NEEDS A BROWSER: src_viu_news_twynam_award has an archive capture,
but VIU's own site search (news.viu.ca/?s=Twynam) RENDERS ITS RESULTS IN
JAVASCRIPT and returns 200 with no result links in the HTML, so the live
replacement URL cannot be found from here either. Same wall as BAnQ (f_5362).

=====================================================================
WHAT THE AUDIT IS ACTUALLY FOR
=====================================================================

Not tidiness. A source record whose URL 404s reads, to the next person, as
evidence that the source is gone -- and today two of them were our own typos
and six more are one click from readable. The failure mode this audit exists
to prevent is the one f_5364 records: a mistyped URL recorded as a fact about
the site, which then sits in the index looking like link rot for a year.

RE-RUN IT with sources/cache/web/, the worklist builder and the threaded
checker kept in the session scratchpad; the whole pass took about ninety
seconds at eight workers.
